title.narrative: SafeJournalists Network

description.narrative:
Overall objective of the action is to contribute to creating an enabling environment in which freedom of expression is fully exercised while violence, threats and pressures against journalists are promptly and accurately followed up by law enforcement and the judicial authorities, as well as publicly condemned by government officials.  

Specific objective(s) i.e. Outcome(s) include:

Outcome 1: Improved legal and institutional framework safeguarding journalists¿ safety, freedom of expression and information ¿ evidenced in number of relevant legal and policy changes as well as improved institutional response to follow up timely and efficiently investigate attacks on journalists.

Outcome 2: Network of actors gathered by SafeJournalists, advocates sustainable solutions to protect women journalists and media professionals ¿ evidenced in the number of policy recommendations provided in cooperation with women¿s right groups, as well as expressed interest in the topic by key national and regional actors.

Outcome 3: Local journalists in the Western Balkan region, empowered to claim their rights as a result of enhanced engagement of SafeJournalists network with local grassroots civil society initiatives - evidenced in an increased number of local journalists reporting violations of their rights via local organisations and SafeJournalists platforms.
